sources.title: The Praying Mantids
sources.citation: Prete, F.R., Wells, H., Wells, P.H., and Hurd, L.E. (eds). 1999. The Praying Mantids. Johns Hopkins University Press.
sources.applicability: Order-level Mantodea background. Not species-specific. Not a CarePlan for an unidentified animal in temporary housing.

claims.text: Mantises are predatory and typically take live prey. Exact prey identity and count depend on taxon and instar.
Numerical feeding prescriptions require a reviewed CarePlan applicable to a known life stage.
